findings.summary: Round-1 f11-1 is resolved (both paths listed, deletions visible). Residual: a rename declared under its old path makes the new path an undeclared entry, and a rename declared under its new path leaves the old path undeclared. Under spec 17 the reviewer may flag the other half of a declared rename. Suggest: when git reports a rename pair (diff -M --name-status), a declaration of either path covers both. Receipt spec-11-r2-probe.log section 2.
findings.assumption: The spec does not decide renames; the reviewer can see the pair in the list and judge it.

findings.summary: The requested non-test samples are all false, but the new rules catch some app code: a camelCase folder ending in Test (src/main/kotlin/com/x/abTest/Flags.kt, from /^[a-z]+Test$/), and Kotlin/Java names ending in Spec or Test (ProductSpec.kt, SplitTest.java, LoadTest.java). src/spec/openapi.ts matches the spec-mandated spec segment (same as round 1). Such a file would show as an undeclared test change. Suggest limiting the camelCase segment to known source sets (androidTest, jvmTest, commonTest, integrationTest, unitTest) and the Spec suffix to .groovy/.scala/.kt under a test source set. Receipt spec-11-r2-probe.log section 1.
findings.assumption: These are rare in practice, and the reviewer judges each undeclared entry.
